business_case: Build an AI-focused job portal that connects candidates with machine learning and data science roles. Strategic goals: (1) reduce manual recruiter effort by 60%, (2) onboard 500+ registered candidates in Q1, (3) GDPR-compliant candidate data handling end-to-end, and (4) full audit logging of every recruiter action for traceability. The platform must support role-based access for Candidates and Recruiters and use AI matching to surface the most relevant open roles per candidate.
